title: 第1章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

也许是魏朝一年里有一半气候阴冷，人人爱香。若手捧的暖炉里添一搓香，无论气味恬淡，还是花香馥郁，都叫人心旷神怡。

若问魏朝当世有名的香料出自何处，自然是京城的香料铺子——守味斋。

稳守京城的铺子，不光靠珍奇的香料，更有秘不外传的调香手段。凭借着无法模仿超越的香味，最近几年里，守味斋的苏家真是日入斗金，吃穿不愁。

都说福贵自古是一家，苏家坐拥金山，“富富”有余，却终究算是个商家，与那权贵还有隔山跨水的距离。

自从苏家大爷苏鸿蒙领了京师榷易院的差事，那脚指头尖总算勉强够到官宦府邸的门槛了，真叫人欣喜若狂。

这榷易院专管魏朝的外海买卖贸易，而大爷在其下的市舶司里专管香料选买。

虽然他只是个小小香药库使，领着微薄的薪俸，可是对于苏家来说，这是儿女们将来登天的腾云梯。

差事办下来后，苏大爷决定带着全家专程去老家荫州的祖祠，叩谢祖宗的阴德庇佑。

一家子准备头腊月上船，这年也要在老家的祖宅里过了。苏大爷决定年后再折返回京，免得耽误新官上任。

别人打点行李都是面带喜色，只苏大爷的嫡出二女儿苏彩笺有些怏怏不乐，臊眉耷眼地看着屋里的几个丫鬟替她打点行装。

苏彩笺的贴身丫鬟喜鹊是个会看眼色的，一看二小姐这霜打的模样，立刻猜出了她的心事。

“二姑娘，您是不愿看见‘她’才不高兴的？”

苏彩笺撕扯着手里的绣花样子，百无聊赖地瞟了喜鹊一眼：“就你话多，真该给你起名叫葫芦，闷起嘴儿来，免了聒噪！”

喜鹊一听，便知自己猜得没错，当下赔笑道：“奴婢若成了哑巴，那您岂不是要闷坏了……二姑娘也多虑了，我老早就问过了给老家送过东西的小厮，‘她’虽然被送到了老家，却并不在老宅里住，据说一年里有几个月都是去山上的庙庵找老尼姑讲义经文。您就算回去了，也不见得能看见她呢！”

听了这话，苏彩笺的脸上露出复杂的神色，既有些释怀，又带了丝惋惜：“……她这是要出家？何必呢？我们苏家又不是寒酸人家，就算她嫁不出去，养她一辈子也行……”

可话锋一转，她又探身问道：“我过去后，当真不会常看见她？”

喜鹊多机灵的一个人，赶紧回道：“放心，奴婢自会跟老宅那边的管事嘱咐好，保管叫姑娘你住得舒心，看不见烦心的人。而且有夫人在，她也会替姑娘考量周详的。再说了，您和陆公子的亲事可是板上钉钉了，俩家换过八字婚帖，也供奉在各家祠堂里月余了，这苏陆两家都是顺风顺水，更上一层楼呢！这就是天作之合，岂是旁人能奈何的？你就甭理会旁人了。”

这话说得苏彩笺满面乌云尽散，想起她的未婚夫陆誓的一表人才，更是喜不自胜。一时间，倒是将心头的担忧抛在了九霄云外。

只是屋外一个听着屋内闲话的小丫鬟侧耳旁听，听了满头的雾水。

她是新来的，自然不知道二小姐话里忌惮的那个“她”是谁，所以跟着喜鹊去库管领月钱时，便好奇地问了一嘴。

Page (1/3)

Maybe it was because the weather was cold and cold for half of the year in the Wei Dynasty, and everyone loved fragrance.If you add a rub of incense to the warmer in your hand, whether the smell is peaceful or the fragrance of flowers is fragrant, it will make people feel relaxed and happy.

If you ask where the famous spices of the Wei Dynasty came from, it is naturally Shouweizhai, a spice shop in the capital.

The shop that maintains its position in the capital not only relies on rare spices, but also has secret fragrance methods.Relying on the inimitable and transcendent fragrance, in recent years, the Su family of Shouweizhai has been making money every day and has no worries about food and clothing.

It is said that the Fugui family has been a family since ancient times. The Su family has a golden mountain and is more than "rich", but it is still a businessman and is still separated from the powerful by mountains and rivers.

Ever since Su Hongmeng, the eldest son of the Su family, took over the errand of Guanyiyuan of the capital, he could barely reach the threshold of the official residence with his toes. It was really ecstatic.

The Kanyi Yuan was responsible for the overseas trade of the Wei Dynasty, while the uncle was responsible for the purchase of spices in the Shipping Department under it.

Although he is just a small incense storekeeper with a meager salary, for the Su family, this is the ladder for their children to reach the sky in the future.

After finishing his errands, Uncle Su decided to take the whole family on a special trip to the ancestral temple in his hometown of Yinzhou to thank his ancestors for their blessings.

The family is preparing to board the ship in the twelfth lunar month of the twelfth lunar month, and will also spend this year in the ancestral home in their hometown.Uncle Su decided to return to Beijing after the new year so as not to delay the new official's appointment.

Everyone else was looking happy as they packed their luggage, but Uncle Su's second daughter, Su Caijian, was a little unhappy. She looked at the maids in the house with frowning eyes as they packed her luggage.

Su Caijian's personal maid Xie Que was a good judge of eyes. Seeing the frosty look on the second young lady's face, he immediately guessed what was on her mind.

"Second girl, you don't want to be unhappy seeing 'her'?"

Su Caijian tore at the embroidery in her hand and glanced at Magpie boredly: "You talk a lot. I should really name you Calabash. Keep your mouth shut to avoid making any noise!"

When the magpie heard this, he knew that his guess was correct. He smiled apologetically and said, "If my servant becomes mute, then you will be bored... The second girl is also worried too much. I have already asked the young man who sent things to my hometown. Although 'she' was sent to my hometown, she does not live in the old house. It is said that for several months of the year, she goes to the temple on the mountain to find the old nun to lecture on scriptures. Even if you go back, you may not be able to see her!"

After hearing this, Su Caijian's face showed a complicated look, with some relief and a hint of regret: "...Is she going to become a monk? Why bother? Our Su family is not a shabby family. Even if she can't get married, we can support her for the rest of her life..."

But when the conversation changed, she leaned forward and asked, "Is it true that I won't see her often after I go there?"

Magpie, a very smart person, quickly replied: "Don't worry, I will tell the steward at the old house to make sure that the girl can live comfortably and you won't see anyone who is bothering you. And with my wife here, she will also consider it carefully for the girl. Besides, you and LuThe marriage of the young master is finalized. The two families have exchanged the eight-character wedding invitations and have enshrined them in various ancestral halls for more than a month.The Su and Lu families are going smoothly and have reached a higher level!This is a match made in heaven, how can you ignore others?"

These words made Su Caijian's face clear of dark clouds. Thinking of her fiancé Lu Xiao's talent, she couldn't be happier.For a moment, the worries in his heart were forgotten.

It was just a little maid outside the house who was listening to the gossip in the house. She listened attentively and was confused.

She was new here, so naturally she didn't know who the "she" that the second lady was afraid of was, so when she followed Magpie to the treasury to collect her monthly payment, she asked curiously.
